fact: Under the Information and Communication Technologies (Registration of SIM) Regulations 2023 (Government Notice 93 of 2023), mobile operators must verify a citizen's National Identity Card details electronically in real time through the Authority and check the applicant's photograph against the NIC photo.
title: Information and Communication Technologies (Registration of SIM) Regulations 2023
publisher: Government of Mauritius, Government Notice No. 93 of 2023
